entryRules.note: No visa required (maximum stay not stated on the page). Air arrivals need a valid return air ticket; land/water arrivals need sufficient funds for stay and departure.
Visa obtainable on arrival at any port of entry, from selected Zambian missions abroad, or online through the eServices e-Visa portal.
Visa must be obtained before travel: advance clearance through the Director General of Immigration (online via eServices) and a letter of approval before travelling.
